title: Your agent can't fix what it can't see
excerpt: Agents are getting better and better at fixing bugs. Or all the bugs that only show up when you account for… well, humans being humans and doing weird stuff you didn't expect them to do? The bottleneck for self-healing software isn't agent intelligence. It's that agents have no idea what actually broke. excerpt: When your application can no longer send or receive messages through an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue, downstream processing can stall. The cause might be a misconfigured Identity and Access Management (IAM) policy, a network partition, a bad deployment, or a transient service event.
